_why: #11/H5: two authors independently corrected one shared fact in the same cycle, one to 18 and one to 20. Each document was internally consistent, so no single-document reviewer could see it and three of the last five cycles' must-fixes were propagation gaps of that shape. Each row restores one way this check can report ADOPTED without having compared anything, or DIVERGED on documents that adopted the sentence perfectly — the two directions cost a missed defect and a switched-off gate respectively.

mutations.name: whitespace-is-not-normalised
mutations._mechanism: A byte comparison reports DIVERGED on a document that adopted the sentence and merely hard-wrapped it. This repo has a measured case of a hard wrap hiding a retired count from every single-line grep for 92 cycles; a gate that fires on correct documents is the calibration error that gets it switched off.

mutations.name: an-empty-sentence-is-trivially-adopted-everywhere
mutations._mechanism: `"" in text` is True for every document, so the check returns ADOPTED on every input and reads as a passing gate while comparing nothing at all.

mutations.name: an-unreadable-document-is-reported-as-a-divergence
mutations._mechanism: 'I could not read it' spelled the same way as 'it did not adopt' — opposite remedies. The reader is sent to edit a document that is not there, and a real divergence elsewhere is masked by the noise.

mutations.name: one-document-counts-as-an-adoption-check
mutations._mechanism: Adoption is a relation between siblings. Run against the source document alone it trivially passes, so a cycle can satisfy the gate without ever comparing two documents.

mutations.name: the-diverging-document-is-not-named
mutations._mechanism: A DIVERGED verdict with no path is a report that something is wrong somewhere among N documents — the reader then re-derives by hand exactly what the check exists to compute.
mutations.find:
for path in result["missing"]:
        print(f"  missing: {path}")

mutations.name: DIVERGED-becomes-an-operational-error
mutations._mechanism: Every h-mad gate is read by TOKEN, never `$?`. A non-zero exit on a verdict makes a caller that checks the exit code treat a real answer as a crash, and the signal-discipline rule exists because this repo has been fooled by rc in both directions.
